pullRequests.title: Keep live readback strict while retrying transient HTTP 503
pullRequests.body:
## Why
The Atelier 17 website is deployed and the full website suite passes. Two production readback attempts stopped on transient HTTP 503 responses at different static files: the first after 119 exact matches, the second after 36 exact matches (before status.html). Neither found a byte mismatch. A single transient response currently stops the entire read-only verification, and its error record omits the failing URL.

## Change
Add a small HTTP opener that retries only HTTP 503, on the same request, up to three total attempts with 2-second and 4-second delays. Every attempt records the exact public URL, status and attempt number. Exhausted or other errors still fail and include the URL. Error responses are closed before retry.

The existing expected-404-page policy, response-size limit, final-host assertion, exact-byte comparison, complete asset list and all public browser checks remain unchanged. No visitor page, asset, frozen baseline or workflow changes.

## Verification
- Five deterministic standard-library unit tests cover recovery after one/two 503s, strict exhaustion, immediate failure for other statuses/network errors, and readable expected 404 responses. No external requests or sleeps in these tests.
- The existing website suite now runs the unit tests as a required early gate.
- Static suite: 5,990 checks, zero failures; all 59 generated files match; diff check passes.
- Hosted browser CI and a new production readback will run through the unchanged workflow.

This is a verification reliability follow-up to #331, not a claim that the origin/CDN cause of HTTP 503 has been identified.

## Final result
Merged as `47e42e194db8cd087e4f3bf22cb5cce3a9145b0d`. [Pages deployment](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/paia/actions/runs/41066850366) and the [final PAIA Website run](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/paia/actions/runs/41066851811) are completed/success. The full website suite passed 10,485 checks; strict production file and browser readback passed 1,521 checks with no failures. An earlier live attempt demonstrated a real 503 recovery on `og-zh.png` on the second attempt; the final successful job preserves all original comparisons and browser assertions.

- Replace the large scroll/perspective Thought Library stage with a flat, continuous reading surface; preserve all four source inputs, three topics, nine chapters and both full reader entries.

- `python website/build.py --check`: all 59 generated files match.
- `PYTHONPATH=/tmp/paia-website-test-deps python website/test.py --static-only`: 5,989 checks, zero failures. Full hosted browser CI passed: 10,484 checks in this design PR; 10,485 after the follow-up verification gate in #332.
- Node syntax and `git diff --check` pass.
- Actual browser review: desktop Chinese hero, Thought Library, Context editing and independent permission switches; R3 expansion and draft preservation; Chinese 390/320 and English 390 responsive layouts. All observed widths remain within the page.

![Desktop homepage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/haohongfei2001-png/paia/3f6976be7cd68c7da711541a21077b778ff9ae12/website/receipts/atelier17-20261030/desktop-zh.jpg)

Publishing follows the existing website CI and GitHub Pages workflow. The store listing remains unavailable; calls to action lead to the real product demo rather than claiming an install is ready.

## Final published verification
- Published main revision: `47e42e194db8cd087e4f3bf22cb5cce3a9145b0d` (includes the readback reliability follow-up #332).
- [GitHub Pages deployment](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/paia/actions/runs/41066850366): success.

pullRequests.title: PAIA 官网重新设计：表达、原文与自主开放（第三版）
pullRequests.body:
## 为什么重做

前两版没有建立足够清楚的产品识别：首屏偏向泛化口号与大窗口，页面节奏和移动端阅读也没有达到审阅要求。第三版重新组织首页与关键内页，让个人表达、原文来源、继续思考和自主开放直接出现在可操作的页面中。

## 本次设计与实现

- 首页采用不对称构图：品牌说明与可读、可编辑的表达并置。原始来源和工作文字分层；切换记录时来源日期同步更新。
- Input Archive、Thought Library 和 AI Context 使用各自适合的空间；Prompt Reuse 保持独立作用。思想库采用展开阅读，Context 保留四类内容的独立控制。
- How It Works 压缩重复导语，把实际表达提前到首屏；使用场景采用可展开的连续叙述；文章保持长文阅读结构。
- About 完整保留创作者原画，保留“是否投递、想表达什么均未知”的故事边界。
- 重新调整中英文字体、层级、留白、对比度与窄屏比例。移动端 Context 使用紧凑的四行控制，并明确打开详情的入口。
- 保留全部现有路由、语言切换、下载/Beta/联系入口、隐私与法律页面。修改 Python 生成源、共享组件与样式，并重新生成网站文件。
- 提供包含全部页面、字体、图像与交互的单文件离线预览，以及可维护的网站源码包。

## 产品边界

原始输入保持不可变，工作文字可以修改。采集、处理、外部读取、云同步仍是独立权限；Context 四类内容不冒充四项产品权限。编辑不自动授权，子项不打开父级，总访问暂停保留选择。Prompt Reuse 不覆盖已有草稿、不自动发送。未配置商店地址时安装按钮保持不可用。

仅修改网站及网站验证/打包资料，没有修改扩展程序、数据库或真实产品权限实现。未合并，未部署生产。

## Changes
- Reuse only immutable string normalization and identity aliases within one Gmail batch. Do not cache opportunities, match decisions, parser results or clocks; preserve scan order and ambiguity rules.
- Bound each memo map to 2,048 entries, keys to 512 characters and the combined scope to 524,288 retained UTF-16 code units (not a byte/heap-size guarantee). Oversized/full cases compute the original result rather than truncate evidence.
- Check an already-applied semantic run before cloning its entire snapshot. New runs keep existing mutation, receipt and CAS behavior.

## Verification
- Failure-first regression recorded; the optional-scope callback/index regression is covered by bank-branch and bilingual alias cases.
- 4,977 unit tests across 377 files, TypeScript and build passed.
- Independent review: 1,415 full-field differential comparisons plus 15 cache-boundary/exception groups passed; frozen file hashes match.
- A synthetic 20-message/1,000-opportunity workload with warmup and alternating order reduced parser computation while preserving complete outputs. This is not a production latency or reliability guarantee.

No SQL, permissions, runtime budget, timeout, empty-poll eligibility or production payload changes. Existing non-replay semantic snapshot clones remain. All applicable remote CI gates are required before merge.
